title: Sheinbaum Rejects Collusion With Crime; Fires Back That There Was an Alliance Between the PAN and Criminals
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Alma E.
Muñoz](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz)
originally appeared in the [October 22, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/22/politica/sheinbaum-
rechaza-colusion-con-crimen-revira-que-entre-pan-y-la-delincuencia-si-hubo-
contubernio), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. President Claudia Sheinbaum rejected claims that the arrest
of the [former attorney general of Chihuahua, César
Jáuregui](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/21/politica/dictan-
prision-preventiva-a-cesar-jauregui-ex-fiscal-de-chihuahua-senalado-de-
traicion-a-la-patria), was because he was trying to dismantle a narco
laboratory.

She fired back at the National Action Party (PAN), pointing out that when
there was collusion between the government and organized crime, it was under
the PAN governments, when **the link between the Secretary of Public Security
(Genaro García Luna) and criminal organizations** was recorded.

Refuting the PAN's accusations, she asserted that we would not have the
results we have, **a reduction of more than 50 percent in intentional
homicides** , if there were any collusion with any criminal group:

> We do not, under any circumstances, establish perverse relationships with
> any criminal group or with white-collar criminals.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

After once again showing the evolution of homicides in Mexico, whose upward
trend was cut during the previous administration, she stressed that “this view
falls apart on its own, very absurd.”

She asserted that the most serious aspect of the operation carried out in
Chihuahua was **the participation of agents of the Central Intelligence Agency
(CIA)** , who were also armed in a nighttime deployment that resulted in the
death of two agents of that organization.
